title: Low Starting Population trait evidence and controlled observation

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1835113 (0x001c0069), HLP file offset 462430 (0x00070e5e), topic 280 'Low Starting Population'
provenance.note: Decoded help topic for Low Starting Population; documented-only claim, not a runtime observation.

provenance.location: dialog #150 resource at file offset 0x2fab00, candidate control 302 (caption empty; position-based lead only); no literal 'Low Starting Population' ASCII string was found in the executable by exact-byte search
provenance.note: Executable location of the trait name/control is a lead; it does not prove runtime mechanics.

setup.baseline: A custom race with no other selected trait and otherwise identical wizard choices.
setup.variable: Select only Low Starting Population and record the advantage-point balance and observable effects.
setup.universe: Single-player, fixed small universe with one Turindrones opponent if the runtime exposes it (otherwise record the actual opponent), fixed difficulty, no random events; keep the same seed/settings across trials.

procedure: Create the baseline race and record the step 1-6 settings and advantage-point balance.
Create the same race with only Low Starting Population changed; record the exact advantage-point balance and any disabled controls.
Start the game and record starting technology, planets, fleets, installations and available catalog entries.
Run a controlled comparison for each documented effect, varying one input at a time and repeating at least three trials where randomness may apply.
Record the observed result, game year, settings and any discrepancy from the documented claim.

documented: Starts with 17,500 colonists instead of 25,000, described as 30% fewer (documented-only).
The help warns that the early-game penalty is substantial (documented-only).

unresolved: The 17,500 / 25,000 ratio is 30% fewer only after rounding; the exact starting value must be observed.
Interaction with Accelerated BBS Play and colony setup is unknown.
notes: The help is dated January 1998 and its applicability to stars26i.exe is unverified. No original-game execution is claimed by PR2.
